resources.string: Fix login
Makes signing in with Google and Facebook work.
Hide ads
Hides ads and promoted posts, and the full-screen ad at startup.
Feature flag overrides
Sets TikTok\'s server settings and experiments by key.
Reseam settings button
Adds a button to the Profile tab that opens Reseam Settings.
Downloads
Saves videos and photos without the watermark, even when the author turned saving off.
Filter feed
Hides posts by account, hashtag, words, region, views, likes, age or length.
Hide feed content
Hides chosen kinds of posts, such as LIVE, Shop or AI-generated posts.
Inbox
Hides chosen sections of the Inbox, such as stories and suggested accounts.
Always show the seekbar
Shows the seekbar on every video, not only long ones.
Disable like long-press
Stops holding Like from opening the reaction options.
Hide comment animations
Stops the full-screen effects some words in comments start.
Hide comment suggestions
Hides sticker and emoji suggestions while you type a comment.
Hide follow button
Hides the follow button under the author\'s picture.
Hide LIVE button
Hides the LIVE button at the top of the feed.
Hide quick comments
Hides the emoji bar under videos.
Hide story rings
Hides the story ring around the author\'s picture.
Remove app shortcuts
Removes TikTok\'s shortcuts from its launcher icon.
Show exact counts
Shows full numbers, such as 12,345 instead of 12.3K.
Show poll results
Shows poll results in comments before you vote.
Show upload date
Shows when and where a video was posted.
Clean share links
Shares plain tiktok.com links without tracking.
Open links in browser
Opens links in your browser instead of TikTok\'s.
Remove forward limit
Lets you share a post to more chats at once.
Disable HDR
Plays HDR videos as regular ones.
Disable looping
Stops videos at the end instead of replaying them.
Disable QUIC
Loads videos over HTTPS instead of QUIC.
Keep the refresh rate
Stops TikTok from lowering your screen\'s refresh rate.
Video quality
Limits the video quality TikTok picks.
Privacy
Stops usage reports, watch history reports, the typing indicator and saved searches.
Spoof SIM country
Reports a carrier from another country, where TikTok is blocked in yours. Needs a VPN in that country.
Default country
The country reported until you change it in settings.
Hide notification prompts
Hides the prompts to turn on notifications.
Hide region popups
Hides popups saying a feature is not in your region. The feature stays unavailable.
Disable search autoplay
Plays videos in search results only when you open them.
Hide search suggestions
Hides You may like on the search page.
